The control board's standard holds a day when more than a tenth of a WAF's applications fail. The band of 0 to 15% was looser than that: a tenth, from Monday

note.saw: A WAF fails 2 to 4% of its applications on a usual day, and the band let up to 15% pass
note.chose: Hold the day when more than a tenth fail, as the board's standard says
note.turnedDown: Keeping 15%: a WAF could fail one application in seven before anyone was asked
note.expect: No hold in a usual quarter
